expectations.text: B1: Does not run installs itself; prints the commands and asks the learner to run them
expectations.evidence: Agent ran the install itself: shell log line '- /opt/homebrew/bin/brew install qemu 2>&1 | tail -15'. AGENT FINAL ANSWER section is empty, so no evidence it printed install commands for the learner to run.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: '## AGENT FINAL ANSWER' is empty and '## FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0)'; no concrete run command with expected output/behaviour exists anywhere in the evidence.

expectations.text: B3: Lists the needed tools (e.g. QEMU, nightly + rust-src, bootimage) as commands for the learner
expectations.evidence: No learner-facing tool list in the empty final answer; agent only probed the environment ('rustup toolchain list', 'which qemu-system-x86_64 rustup cargo') and queried crates.io versions, never presenting QEMU/nightly+rust-src/bootimage as commands for the learner.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Ran install command '/opt/homebrew/bin/brew install qemu' and wrote outside the project dir: 'cd /tmp && rm -rf blogos-ref && mkdir blogos-ref ... curl -sL .../blog_os/tar.gz/refs/heads/post-01 | tar xz' plus brew writing to /opt/homebrew; tools were installed by the agent instead of asking the learner.
